blockers.requirement: The jq_fuzz_execute link command must name an Oniguruma archive produced by the configured build.
blockers.target_route: build.sh configures builtin Oniguruma, runs make, then links jq_fuzz_execute against modules/oniguruma/src/.libs/libonig.a.
blockers.failure_condition: That named archive is absent: the supplied build rule produces the builtin Oniguruma library under vendor/oniguruma, so the target link cannot resolve its archive operand.
blockers.alternative_paths: The complete target link command names no alternative archive, and the supplied Makefile.am's builtin rule uses vendor/oniguruma.
